findings.value: A contemporary art gallery and studio organisation on Cambridge Heath Road in Bethnal Green, founded in 1999 and based here since 2003. Its own history says a ground-floor event space was added in 2019.

evidence.quote: Founded in 1999, Cell Project Space was built by artists Milika Muritu & Richard Priestley
In 2003, the gallery and HQ relocated to our current Bethnal Green site, on Cambridge Heath Rd
a recent new addition of a ground-floor multi-purpose event space, opened in the summer 2019

not_found: status (no closure or new-owner news found; the closing and new-owner searches were not run because the search budget ran out)
notes: The Cell history page has no date, so no source_date is set. Its own site lists a forthcoming exhibition opening 7 October and a screening on 12 October (programme researcher's field). I found no independent review or press article about Cell in the searches I could run.
